verdict.rationale: Lithic provides strong fraud-prevention infrastructure at auth time: Authorization Stream Access for custom real-time decisions, a Rules Engine with program/account/card-level controls, velocity/spend limits, shadow mode and backtesting, plus disputes/chargeback filing for compromised cards. However, evidence does not show network fraud scores or Lithic's own ML fraud models surfaced at auth time, nor explicit suspicious-activity alerting tooling, nor a documented one-click 'block and reissue' flow for compromised cards beyond generic card creation. missing for 10: network/Lithic fraud scoring models at authorization, suspicious-activity alert mechanism, explicit card block-and-reissue workflow documentation.
